subject: Brightlane: reprioritizing Q3 launch — pausing LLM pilot and calendar coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Brightlane: Q3 coordination and planned demo — quick check on availability

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. We penciled in a 45-minute technical demo for next Tuesday, May 11, to walk through the inference cost/latency tradeoffs and a short hands-on with our Dedicated flow. Before I send a calendar invite, two quick checks:

- Is the engineering team still available the week of May 10?
- Any last-minute stakeholders (e.g., procurement/CTO) we should include on the invite?

I attached a short one-pager on the baseline perf profile we planned to demo so the team can flag any specific scenarios in advance.

If May 11 is tight, we have open slots on May 13 (afternoon) or May 18. Happy to be flexible.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Brightlane_Roadmap_Priorities_Q3.pdf (PDF)]

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightlane.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlane.com>, procurement@brightlane.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightlane: Q3 coordination and planned demo — quick check on availability

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the follow-up and the one-pager. Quick update from our side: our executive team just finalized priorities for Q3 and elected to accelerate the product launch for a different line of business — that pulled several engineering sprints and the CTO (Samir) into a launch readiness track.

Concretely, that means we need to deprioritize new piloting work that isn’t directly tied to the launch. We won’t be able to commit engineering time for the demo the week of May 10.

That said, we’re still interested in Redwood’s inference economics — we just need to pause active engagement until after the launch window settles (earliest realistic revisit is late July). I copied Samir and procurement on this thread; procurement will flag any contractual/PO questions if we resume.

Apologies for the churn — new launch cadence caught us mid-sprint. Can we mark this as a pause and I’ll reach back when we have a clearer post-launch roadmap?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Data Products, Brightlane
alex.rivera@brightlane.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Brightlane reprioritization — recommend next steps

Team — forwarding Alex's note. Short list of proposed next steps so we keep the deal warm without burning SDR/AE cycles:

1) Mark the opportunity as "paused — customer launch" in HubSpot (deal BR-2027-113) and set a follow-up task for July 25.
2) Share a lightweight tech briefing (1-page) tailored to the launch constraints: focus on low-effort sandbox options they can run without dedicated eng time (hosted API quickstart and a prebuilt notebook).
3) Ask procurement for preferred calendar cadence for resuming (procurement@brightlane.com is copied) — we’ll offer a single 30-minute executive briefing slot in late July.

I attached a draft of the 1-page quickstart (Brightlane-focused). If you want, Marissa, you can own the customer touchpoint and send a short note offering the sandbox and a late-July slot.

Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Brightlane_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Alex / Samir —

Totally understand the Q3 launch pressure — congrats on the prioritization. We’ll keep this light on our side and provide two things that won’t require engineering time from Brightlane:

- A hosted sandbox package (pre-built notebook, sample prompts, and a one-hour on-demand video) that your product managers can explore asynchronously.
- A tentative executive briefing slot the week of July 26 — we’ll hold a single 30-minute slot and you can confirm closer to the date.

If it helps, I’ll attach the sandbox quickstart and a short checklist for the PMs. No obligations — when you’re ready to re-engage we’ll pick up where we left off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0145
